changes.previous_behavior: The progress bar used the generic Practice progress name and exposed only a percentage.
changes.root_cause: Assistive technology did not receive the exam mode or current question position from that progress control.
changes.implementation: Use an exam-specific accessible name and announce Question X of Y as value text; practice retains its own name.
changes.verification_result: PASS_STATIC_AND_HTTP; browser assertions prepared but not executed

changes.previous_behavior: The review page relied on the browser's native form navigation and gave no in-page pending or restored-page guidance.
changes.root_cause: A lost response or Android back-forward-cache restore could leave a learner without clear retry guidance; repeated button taps could submit duplicate requests.
changes.implementation: Announce pending submission without claiming success, block repeat client submits, and unlock a safe retry with truthful guidance when the page is restored from the back-forward cache. Server finalization remains authoritative and idempotent.

changes.previous_behavior: The displayed countdown recalculated and rendered every 250 ms.
changes.root_cause: The interface refreshed four times per second although the displayed timer has whole-second precision.
changes.implementation: Render once per second and immediately catch up on visibility return, focus and pageshow. The server deadline and expiry submission remain authoritative.

recommendation_test_repair.failure: The previous synthetic assertion requested seven exam questions from a three-row pool and expected exactly one result. Existing shortage recovery correctly widened scope to fill the request.
recommendation_test_repair.repair: Retained the seven-item action URL assertion; the separate exact topic/difficulty selection fixture now requests one question and supplies an explicit isolated LET eligibility index.
